subject.title: improve(ios): guide first-run users into gateway onboarding

question: Should the iOS preview-tour onboarding experience be adopted on top of current main, narrowed to a smaller preview-only follow-up, or paused in favor of the newer merged mobile onboarding direction?
rationale: The remaining blocker is partly product direction: this PR adds a new preview/sample onboarding mode while current main has since landed overlapping onboarding, routing, security-copy, and typography decisions.

options.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
options.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, preserved configured-gateway routing, and fresh simulator proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to preview-only follow-up
options.body: Extract only the sample preview pieces maintainers still want and leave setup-code or connection-path changes to focused PRs.

options.title: Pause or close this branch
options.body: Treat the current merged mobile onboarding refresh as the maintained direction if the preview tour is no longer desired.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, preserved configured-gateway routing, and fresh simulator proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: joshavant authored the merged current-main onboarding/security-copy work that now conflicts with and should calibrate this branch's rebase direction.
